causal_clock_controls.reason: The exact clock variables, timezone/session semantics and encoding are not specified.

hourly_price_location.reason: No unique location transformation, completed-hour anchor or treatment of flat high-low intervals is specified.

last_completed_M5_projection.reason: The prose does not say whether the raw last bar, selected price fields or a derived M5 state enter B_t.

range_projection.reason: Which M5/hour interval, price-unit versus normalized/log range representation and degeneracy law are not fixed.
